results.Description: ITEMS ARE NEEDED TO SUSTAIN CRITICAL OPERATIONAL FUNCTIONS OF BOTH THE INSTITUTIONAL MISSION SIMULATOR (IMS) AND THE PORTABLE INSTITUTIONAL MISSION SIMULATOR (PIMS) SYSTEM (UAS) UNMANNED AIRCRAFT SYSTEM (UAS) SYSTEM. FAILURE TO PURCHASE CRITICAL IT SUPPORT ITEMS WILL DECREASE THE EFFECTIVENESS OF THE TRAINING FOR THE UAS CREWS IN THE FIELDS OF CREW COORDINATION, RULES OF ENGAGEMENT, RECONNAISSANCE, SENSOR OPERATIONS, AND THREAT IDENTIFICATION WHILE FLYING IN  A SIMULATED ENVIRONMENT THAT ACCURATELY REPRESENTS THE UNITS FUTURE AREA OF OPERATIONS.  THE WILL DRAMATICALLY REDUCE THE OPERATIONAL READINESS OF ARMY UAS FORCES.
